SELECT (created_at)::date AS day,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event = 'homepage_view'::text)) AS homepage,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event = 'anonymous_generation_started'::text)) AS gen_started,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event = 'anonymous_generation_completed'::text)) AS gen_completed,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event = 'signup_gate_seen'::text)) AS gate_seen,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event = 'signup_after_anon'::text)) AS signup_after_anon,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event = 'paid_after_anon'::text)) AS paid_after_anon,
    count(DISTINCT actor_id) FILTER (WHERE (event = 'anonymous_generation_completed'::text)) AS gen_actors
   FROM analytics_events
  GROUP BY ((created_at)::date);

SELECT (created_at)::date AS day,
    capture_point,
    tier,
    population_band,
    prosperity,
    count(*) AS n,
    avg(legitimacy) AS avg_legitimacy,
    avg(food_resilience) AS avg_food_resilience
   FROM settlement_snapshots
  GROUP BY ((created_at)::date), capture_point, tier, population_band, prosperity;

SELECT (created_at)::date AS day,
    kind,
    target_kind,
    count(*) AS edits,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE reverted) AS reverts
   FROM edit_events
  GROUP BY ((created_at)::date), kind, target_kind;

SELECT (created_at)::date AS day,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event = 'ai_generation_started'::text)) AS ai_started,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event = 'ai_generation_completed'::text)) AS ai_completed,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event = 'ai_generation_failed'::text)) AS ai_failed,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event = 'credits_spent'::text)) AS credit_spends
   FROM analytics_events
  GROUP BY ((created_at)::date);
